2610.33024.update_target: External task skills guided by a fixed capability-adaptation meta-skill; model weights stay fixed
2610.33024.mechanism_en: Execution traces and verifier feedback drive five rounds of skill revision. The meta-skill diagnoses whether the executor can follow the procedure, and the revised skill is reused in the next round.
2610.33024.boundary_en: The adaptation meta-skill is fixed, not recursively learned here. Skills useful to strong models can hurt weaker models; rewriting without execution evidence differs from verified self-revision.

2610.33046.update_target: Runtime search strategies, population management, diagnostic tools, memory and worker coordination
2610.33046.mechanism_en: A persistent agent inspects search experience and swaps executable search mechanisms during the run. It can reverse earlier revisions and revise procedures governing later adaptation.
2610.33046.boundary_en: These are finite computational searches with task evaluators. Runtime self-modification and trajectory examples do not establish unlimited improvement or universal transfer.

2610.33487.update_target: External memory builders, derived fields, query tools and reusable skills over retained observations
2610.33487.mechanism_en: Explore–Distill–Mount identifies capability gaps from execution and exploration records without task reference answers, then mounts reusable programs and skills; raw observations remain revisitable.
2610.33487.boundary_en: Capability development has a larger exploration budget and may acquire models; deployment savings exclude neither that work nor acquisition cost. Robot patrol-memory queries differ from autonomous physical control.

2610.33539.update_target: Collaboration skills, skill memory and executor memories
2610.33539.mechanism_en: Local skills connect workflow choices with supporting memory. Original and counterfactual trajectories supply evolution signals that coordinate all three persistent components across rounds.
2610.33539.boundary_en: This evolves external collaboration and memory, not model weights. Counterfactual sampling adds search cost; two interactive benchmarks do not establish open-ended cooperation.

2610.33845.update_target: Simulator, opponents, PPO-trained game policy and external research-process memory
2610.33845.mechanism_en: Specialized research agents share typed claims, verification gates and live-game feedback. The same evidence revises the game system and subsequent research workflow; humans set goals and adjudicate ambiguous rules.
2610.33845.boundary_en: A live ladder snapshot is not a controlled causal test of research self-improvement. Human adjudication, simulator fidelity and policy training matter; the release excludes trained-player weights and training code.

2610.34921.update_target: Shared VLM policy weights via GRPO and an adaptive physical-intent curriculum
2610.34921.mechanism_en: The model proposes executable worlds; a deterministic physics engine validates and freezes them, simulates matched interventions, and creates answer-bound tasks. Verified solving feedback updates the policy and future curriculum.
2610.34921.boundary_en: Training uses simulator-authored truth, not human intervention labels; that does not remove simulator assumptions or compute. Selected benchmark gains are not uniform physical competence or real-robot improvement.

2610.35051.update_target: Executable embodied-agent harness code, skills, memory and decision logic; underlying models fixed
2610.35051.mechanism_en: A meta-agent retrieves harness lineage, actively probes a simulator, revises the harness and submits a frozen candidate for fresh autonomous evaluation. The code and evidence become later development inputs.
2610.35051.boundary_en: Active exploration and evaluation consume simulator rollouts and model calls. The public code currently covers LIBERO-Pro T/S, not all three benchmark integrations or the evolved task-specific harnesses.

2610.35316.update_target: External text-to-visualization harness revisions with fixed language-model weights
2610.35316.mechanism_en: Failure traces propose harness changes. Anchor and memory checks gate revisions; accepted variants are refined, while failed proposals restore the best validated harness for subsequent work.
2610.35316.boundary_en: A single demonstrated round supports local harness improvement, not sustained recursive gains. Executable charts and structural accuracy are separate from semantic analytical correctness.

2610.35434.update_target: Task-skill packages and the reusable meta-skill defining their optimization procedure
2610.35434.mechanism_en: A meta-agent follows the meta-skill to diagnose traces, propose edits, obtain independent reviews and allocate budget. The same procedure optimizes the meta-skill across tasks before transfer to new skill optimization.
2610.35434.boundary_en: The infinity notation is a method name, not evidence of infinite improvement. Independent review remains model-based; the inspected repository promises a future code release and is linked as Project only.

2610.35616.update_target: Hierarchical external skills, writer rules and evaluator feature weights; coding model frozen
2610.35616.mechanism_en: Task evidence is aggregated within and across repositories. Training updates writer rules and small evaluator evidence coefficients, then validates the joint evolution state on held-out tasks; target adaptation freezes those controllers.
2610.35616.boundary_en: Evaluator feature-weight changes are not coding-LLM fine-tuning. Static transfer and eight-round target-benchmark adaptation are different protocols; evaluation labels used for reporting are separate from adaptation feedback.

2610.33245.update_target: Persistent same-task workspace knowledge and adaptive process-supervision rubrics
2610.33245.mechanism_en: A process reward agent executes checks over trajectories and artifacts, adapting rubrics that correct later attempts. Rubrics seeded on easier tasks or one model can be reused elsewhere.
2610.33245.boundary_en: These are leaderboard percentiles, not accuracy points. Same-task accumulation is distinct from cross-task learning; the auditor and five-attempt budget must be counted.

2610.33465.update_target: Solver choices, constrained searches and reusable lessons in a scientific-discovery agent
2610.33465.mechanism_en: Seven solvers share an equation representation and evaluation interface. The agent uses intermediate results and earlier-task lessons to choose and adapt later searches, including partially known equations.
2610.33465.boundary_en: Equation recovery is benchmark evidence, not a new physical law certified by the digest. A reusable solver-selection mechanism is not recursive revision of the entire research system.

2610.33799.update_target: Separate trainable QA-generator and search-solver policies
2610.33799.mechanism_en: Image-grounded seeds initiate online verified multi-hop generation. A Goldilocks reward favors intermediate solver success, and independent GRPO objectives update the two policies without shared parameters or gradients.
2610.33799.boundary_en: No precomputed multi-hop corpus does not mean no seed data, retrieval or training cost. Frontier difficulty depends on rollout success and on the correctness of question verification.

2610.33861.update_target: Task-specific synthesized guidance for a fresh execution; no parameter updates
2610.33861.mechanism_en: One coach call jointly consolidates bounded source attempts and artifacts. A student restarts from the original environment and adapts the guidance to observations using the same base model.
2610.33861.boundary_en: The combined construction/execution savings in the abstract exclude source generation. Same-task re-execution is not proof that a persistent cross-task learner improves; count the source pool for lifecycle cost.

2610.33876.update_target: Reusable neuro-symbolic programs compiled from successful workflows
2610.33876.mechanism_en: Actions become code, instance values become parameters and irreducible judgments remain localized model calls. Deterministic code and neural calls can be tested separately before recurring reuse.
2610.33876.boundary_en: Template-instance transfer is narrower than arbitrary workflow generalization. Compilation localizes nondeterminism rather than removing it; maintenance and compilation cost require separate accounting.

2610.34043.update_target: External skill claims and corrective lessons with support, contradiction, replacement and retirement states
2610.34043.mechanism_en: Verifier evidence turns successful behavior into skills and failures into lessons. New evidence changes claim status, allowing validated knowledge to guide subsequent tasks instead of merely accumulating summaries.
2610.34043.boundary_en: Reliability depends on verifier and claim scope. The inspected release is the main Terminus-2 experiment and omits benchmark tasks; it does not independently reproduce all agent-agnostic claims.

2610.34260.update_target: Typed procedural skill graphs and their external revisions
2610.34260.mechanism_en: Heterogeneous agents identify experience-backed issues, debate dependent edits and compile them into a graph artifact. Multidimensional gates check information gain and topology before reuse.
2610.34260.boundary_en: A structurally valid graph need not improve execution. Do not infer unreported effect sizes or global optimality from the abstract’s convergence language; graph compilation and debate incur overhead.

2610.34450.update_target: Per-agent structured memory and reusable partner profiles/interaction strategies
2610.34450.mechanism_en: An isolated MemoryAgent updates observed episodic, semantic and working evidence within an episode; episode outcomes then distill cross-episode knowledge for future interaction.
2610.34450.boundary_en: This is external test-time adaptation with fixed model parameters. Partner profiles and private observations must preserve visibility constraints; the public plug-in is not the complete experiment suite.

2610.34500.update_target: Data-curation recipes and calibrated persistent claims about their applicability
2610.34500.mechanism_en: Before executing a recipe, the agent predicts its outcome. Prediction error then supports, revises or conditions stored claims, shaping later search rather than treating one failure as a universal rejection.
2610.34500.boundary_en: The maximum gain is task-dependent; recipe evaluation includes downstream training. Better search memory does not establish improved general reasoning or eliminate validation overfitting.

2610.34679.update_target: Shared tool descriptions and, where permitted, implementations; consuming agents fixed
2610.34679.mechanism_en: An offline coding agent reads historical trajectories and task rewards, then edits the tool environment. Held-out paired evaluations test whether those provider-side edits transfer to later executions.
2610.34679.boundary_en: Tool usability, error rate and final task correctness are different outcomes. This is environment-side optimization from traces, not weight learning; public code is a pre-release with external benchmark dependencies.

2610.34724.update_target: Fast external strategy cards and slower model-parameter updates
2610.34724.mechanism_en: Trajectories become immediately retrievable cards; experience-conditioned continual learning trains the model to execute them. Retrieval coverage selects compact complementary trajectories for updates.
2610.34724.boundary_en: This trains model parameters as well as storing memory; it is not training-free. The abstract gives no numerical aggregate or hardware budget, so neither is inferred.

2610.34977.update_target: Persistent per-memory retrieval-access state and an optionally trained selection policy; stored content unchanged
2610.34977.mechanism_en: Deployment keep/suppress decisions accumulate into bounded reweighting of future retrieval. A teacher-distilled policy supplies selectivity, while a zero-call frequency policy provides a strong control.
2610.34977.boundary_en: The deployment layer avoids retraining the host, but its trained policy uses LoRA distillation. Suppressing frequently useful memories can hurt; access improvement is distinct from content learning.

2610.35598.update_target: Proposer/solver training and a graph-topology curriculum
2610.35598.mechanism_en: Symbolically executed graph queries provide complete answer sets for generated tasks. Self-play alternates proposing and solving, with solver score variance keeping the curriculum near its capability boundary.
2610.35598.boundary_en: Annotation-free still relies on graph facts, executable topology and training. The linked repository postpones SVTS synthesis code, task sets and checkpoints; it is not treated as a complete Code release.

2610.33029.update_target: Outcome-derived lesson text affecting a later tool-choice decision
2610.33029.mechanism_en: Registered synthetic worlds separate a good/bad prior decision from lucky/unlucky outcomes. Fresh same-model readers receive authoritative logs plus controlled lesson variants; matched contrasts test whether chance becomes guidance.
2610.33029.boundary_en: This measures one memory-to-decision link, not end-to-end long-horizon RSI. A bounded effect is not proof of no harm; proposed writing fixes fail the registered harm-reduction rule at some endpoints.

2610.33528.update_target: Evaluation of reusable web skills under contextual, perceptual and execution shifts
2610.33528.mechanism_en: Three self-hosted systems provide controlled environment changes, task/cost/skill-failure diagnostics, a dynamic-regret analysis and test-time execution adaptation without relearning the library.
2610.33528.boundary_en: Controlled shifts support robustness diagnosis rather than all real-world web drift. A local executability repair does not establish persistent skill-library evolution.

2610.33624.update_target: Agent-designed post-training data, training code and model checkpoints, with second-stage human feedback
2610.33624.mechanism_en: Ten agents train a common base model, receive votes/comparison records on their own first-stage output and train again. A common reference and style-adjusted human ratings compare stages.
2610.33624.boundary_en: Each first-stage agent gets 1,000 GPU-hours and $300 API credit; this is not a low-compute recipe. Preference, benchmark and safety gains diverge, and stronger human ratings do not certify a self-improving successor.

2610.33956.update_target: Evaluation of experience reuse across five-level professional-task ladders
2610.33956.mechanism_en: Passing a level unlocks the next; an evaluator applies human-authored rubrics. A second setting permits diagnostic failure feedback and one revision, enabling comparison of accumulated experience and feedback access.
2610.33956.boundary_en: Ladder completion and a one-revision gain do not isolate persistent learning from context, feedback or selection. Judge reliability and unlocked-task exposure matter; no independent continual-learning experiment was run here.

2610.34073.update_target: Evaluation of net memory value relative to retrieval from raw history
2610.34073.mechanism_en: The analysis separates memory benefit from memory tax: reorganization can help but may erase or obscure evidence. A naive RAG reference tests whether memory processing actually adds value.
2610.34073.boundary_en: This is not evidence that all memory is harmful. Retrieval budgets, corpus visibility, construction costs and benchmark design determine the relevant comparison.

2610.34386.update_target: Multi-domain data-curation and post-training loop; fixed base models, tools, domains and SFT pipeline
2610.34386.mechanism_en: Agents search/curate data, train and read five-domain proxy results over five rounds. Hidden generalization benchmarks assess proxy-best checkpoints and domain tradeoffs.
2610.34386.boundary_en: A best checkpoint selected by proxy differs from best hidden-test selection. LoRA/model training changes weights even when the data is the only agent-controlled variable; benchmark files are not yet in the release.

2610.34577.update_target: Task-local verification/revision effort across four harness lifecycle layers
2610.34577.mechanism_en: Seventeen designs vary instructions, reminders, completion gates and independent review. Matched coding tests and expert visual judgments compare accuracy with cost rather than presuming more checking helps.
2610.34577.boundary_en: Test-time revision is not persistent self-improvement unless its lessons are retained and validated on later tasks. Gains and review costs vary by model and benchmark.

2610.34634.update_target: Frozen reusable acceptance programs tested against changed requirements and subsequent policy execution
2610.34634.mechanism_en: Paired program panels and decision replay are linked to fresh execution from identical saved openings. Neutral continuation tests whether a gate adds value over simply letting the agent proceed.
2610.34634.boundary_en: Verifier reuse is a hypothesis, not a certificate. Program correctness and delivery correctness are distinct units; associations across the tested assignments are not universal causal guarantees.

2610.34767.mechanism_en: An executable factory creates histories, deterministic oracles and controlled counterfactual/repair tests. State compilation exposes dependencies such as selection and stopping rules before evidence is used.
2610.34767.boundary_en: Correct retrieval can still license an invalid inference. These are synthetic scientific-state tests, not a validation of autonomous discoveries in laboratories.

2610.34938.update_target: Evaluation of retrospective coding-harness proposals and their later-task effects
2610.34938.mechanism_en: Thirty sessions produce 125 proposals; 24 are implemented and 12 changes tested on later same-repository issues in fresh sessions with/without the change. Recurrence and actual consultation are measured.
2610.34938.boundary_en: A proposal count is not a learning gain. Targeted issue selection, small samples and one agent/version limit inference; the method needs continued validation and retirement of stale changes.

2610.35193.update_target: Conceptual evaluation of persistent updates and revisions to improvement mechanisms
2610.35193.mechanism_en: The survey separates diagnosis, proposal, evaluation and implementation, plus recursion over those stages. Improvement validity, constraint preservation and effective oversight organize longitudinal evidence requirements.
2610.35193.boundary_en: Direct RSI evidence is distinguished from adjacent systems. Definitions and process diagrams do not certify a specific system’s reliability or repair an invalid evaluator.

2610.35215.update_target: Skill lifecycle state: stored code, selected version and loaded implementation
2610.35215.mechanism_en: Paired runtime/lifecycle tasks couple executable requests with registered attack goals; recovery interventions test provenance and deterministic execution consistency.
2610.35215.boundary_en: Task completion alone can coexist with an attack. The 388 source scenarios, 89 runtime tasks and 60 lifecycle tasks are different units; summarize security outcomes without operational attack instructions.

2610.35579.update_target: Editable research-agent genome behind an immutable evaluation/cost kernel
2610.35579.mechanism_en: Fresh sandbox proposers see public scores, while private checks gate genome changes. Autonomous verifier construction adds calibration, adversarial auditing and a separate rechecker.
2610.35579.boundary_en: Better research artifacts do not prove improved self-improvement. $180 is model usage, not full compute/labor cost; hardware energy comes from an RTL-to-GDS design flow, not fabricated-chip measurement.

2610.35604.update_target: Fixed-weight execution harness, intervention policy and operation methods with linked experience
2610.35604.mechanism_en: Diagnosis connects decisions, attempted actions, outcomes and reuse conditions. Stored interactions illustrate changes to control allocation, selective assistance and physical-method reasoning.
2610.35604.boundary_en: The paper explicitly requires controlled trials to isolate cross-episode experience. These simulation-archive scores and interaction examples are not evidence of a causal lifelong-learning gain or independent real-robot replication.

2610.35716.update_target: Strong-verifier audit allocation and reward corrections during GRPO weight training
2610.35716.mechanism_en: A fixed-state analysis separates marginal audit probability from correction. Low-pass group audits prioritize weakly passing groups whose remaining hack advantage is most costly; actual training tests the prediction.
2610.35716.boundary_en: The optimality statement is conditional on a frozen-state objective and audit-design assumptions. Equal expected updates can have different training outcomes because variance matters; label savings are not total compute savings.

2610.35866.update_target: Evaluation of research-generated model/data/training/inference changes and later reuse of discoveries
2610.35866.mechanism_en: Nine targets separate admissibility constraints from progress metrics. Seven research harnesses with two foundation models search a shared environment; discoveries are reused in a fresh quality-driven search.
2610.35866.boundary_en: No single target measures all research value. The inspected HTML is v2 while abstracts retain the saved New listing; constraints and search expenditure matter when comparing efficiency claims.
